entries.title: Law 26/2016, access and reuse of administrative documents

cells: Governs public access and reuse, with privacy, copyright and other exceptions. Online reuse generally does not need permission absent a contrary indication or clear copyright protection; attribution and no distortion conditions apply. This is not an API specification.
